title: graphistylis dichroa
intro: Graphistylis dichroa, commonly known as the dichroa, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is native to Asia, where it has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The dichroa plant is said to have various health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the dichroa plant include iridoid glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects.
